basic_profile.bio: I'm a midwestern farmer by day and a gamer by night. Living in Iowa, I balance my life between tending to real crops and virtual ones in Township. My interests lie in maximizing productivity both in real life and in games. I dislike when gaming mechanics are overly complicated without adding value. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after a long day on the farm. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time gaming, watching anime, and exploring new tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in agriculture with a degree from Iowa State University. My knowledge comes from both formal education and hands-on experience. I'm a self-taught gamer, with a keen interest in strategy games that involve farming and resource management.
